schools.name: School of Foundational Social Work Practice & Ethics
new: Social Work Values and Ethical Decision Making
Person in Environment and Human Development
Communication Interviewing and Helping Relationships
Generalist Assessment and Case Management
Professional Recording Consent and Confidentiality
Referral Networks and Interprofessional Practice
Reflective Practice Boundaries and Supervision
schools.scope: Generalist practice across settings, including the three unchanged health social work courses. These retain their healthcare scope; the school does not become a clinical specialization.

schools.name: School of Ecosocial Resilience and Environmental Social Work
new: Ecosocial Systems and Environmental Justice
Participatory Ecological Vulnerability Assessment
Community Adaptation and Resilience Planning
Heat Pollution and Environmental Health Inequity
Climate Displacement and Livelihood Adaptation
Indigenous Knowledge and Community Stewardship
Evaluating Ecosocial Interventions
schools.scope: Community resilience, environmental injustice and adaptation. The existing climate course has one home here; blue economy and organizational sustainability remain distinct.

schools.name: School of Gender Studies and Gender-Based Violence Prevention
new: Gender Power and Intersectionality
Survivor Centred First Response and Referral
GBV Case Management and Safety Planning
Trauma Informed Support and Service Coordination
Community Prevention and Social Norms Change
Child Marriage FGM and Harmful Practices
Technology Facilitated Abuse and Digital Safety
Ethical GBV Data and Programme Evaluation
schools.scope: Prevention, safe survivor support, referral and accountable programming. It does not authorize clinical treatment or specialist forensic practice.

schools.name: School of Mental Health and Psychosocial Care
new: Trauma Informed and Culturally Responsive Psychosocial Care
Community Mental Health Rights and Recovery
Child Adolescent and Family Psychosocial Support
Mental Health Service Coordination and Safe Referral
schools.scope: Keep all six clinical and addiction courses unchanged. Add population, cultural, rights and service-system coverage rather than replacing their CBTs.

schools.name: School of Community Development and Participatory Engagement
new: Participatory Facilitation and Community Dialogue
Asset Based Community Development
Community Accountability and Grievance Mechanisms
Inclusive Local Planning and Co Design
Community Programme Implementation Practicum
schools.scope: Community organizing, participation, planning and delivery. Research design belongs primarily to RDS and Nigerian-content compliance to SNC.

schools.name: School of Child Protection and Safeguarding
new: Child Rights and Safeguarding Systems
Child Centred Assessment Participation and Referral
Online Child Safety and Exploitation Prevention
Safeguarding in Organizations and Safer Recruitment
Child Protection Case Coordination Practicum
schools.scope: Child and family safety across prevention, response and organizational safeguarding. Preserve the three existing family welfare courses exactly.

schools.name: School of Social Policy and Governance
new: Social Protection Systems and Welfare Governance
Public Finance Budget Analysis and Accountability
Policy Design Implementation and Evaluation
Decentralization and Inclusive Public Administration
Social Policy Political Economy and Inequality
Participatory Governance and Public Consultation
Policy Briefing and Reform Practicum
schools.scope: Public policy and institutional governance. Legislative campaigning is housed in AHR; policy-data methods are housed in RDS.

schools.name: School of Social Entrepreneurship and Enterprise Development
new: Social Enterprise Models and Social Innovation
Community Market Research and Value Propositions
Business Models Costing and Cash Flow
Social Finance Cooperative Models and Inclusion
Impact Measurement and Mission Accountability
Social Enterprise Launch Practicum
schools.scope: Enterprise design and viability alongside social purpose. It is distinct from donor fundraising in FGR and occupational skills in VTS.

schools.name: School of Digital Innovation and Artificial Intelligence in Social Work
new: Digital Inclusion Accessibility and Service Design
Data Protection Consent and Cyber Hygiene
AI Literacy Limits Bias and Human Oversight
Responsible AI for Casework Documentation
Digital Case Management and Workflow Design
Evaluating Digital and AI Enabled Services
Digital Innovation Design Practicum
schools.scope: Digital practice and critical AI literacy with explicit limits, privacy, bias evaluation and accountable human judgement.

schools.name: School of Climate Change and Blue Economy Social Work
new: Coastal Communities and Blue Economy Foundations
Fisheries Livelihoods Labour and Social Protection
Coastal Climate Risk and Inclusive Adaptation
Marine Conservation Justice and Participation
Blue Finance and Community Benefit Assessment
Coastal Livelihoods Planning Practicum
schools.scope: Coastal and marine livelihoods, ocean governance and community benefit. Avoid duplicating ERT general resilience or SUS institutional sustainability.

schools.name: School of Extractive Industries, Livelihoods and SW-EMHEC
new: Extractive Sector Social Work and Community Relations
Social and Environmental Impact Assessment Literacy
Livelihood Restoration and Just Transition
Community Health Risks and Referral Coordination
Land Displacement and Community Benefit Negotiation
Grievance Conflict and Stakeholder Engagement
Corporate Accountability and Community Monitoring
Extractives Community Intervention Practicum
schools.scope: Cross-sector extractive impacts and livelihoods. Confirm the owner-defined meaning of SW-EMHEC before finalizing the school outcome map; SNC and SPIA handle distinct statutory applications.

schools.name: School of Humanitarian Action and Disaster Response
new: Humanitarian Principles and Quality Standards
Rapid Needs Assessment and Inclusive Response
Protection Accountability and Prevention of Exploitation
Humanitarian Coordination and Referral Systems
Humanitarian Response Simulation
schools.scope: Operational preparedness, relief and recovery. Conflict mediation, displacement and peacebuilding receive distinct treatment in DCS.

schools.name: School of Research Methods and Data for Social Impact
new: Research Questions Designs and Evidence Appraisal
Qualitative Inquiry and Thematic Analysis
Quantitative Methods Statistics and Interpretation
Mixed Methods and Ethical Data Collection
Monitoring Evaluation and Learning Systems
Research Ethics Data Stewardship and Reporting
schools.scope: Research, critical appraisal and evaluation methods, including the unchanged policy-data course and participatory research course.

schools.name: School of Leadership, Management and Institutional Development
new: Strategy and Organizational Development
Human Resources Team Development and Wellbeing
Financial Management and Internal Controls
Governance Boards and Institutional Accountability
Change Management and Quality Improvement
Partnership and Programme Portfolio Management
Institutional Development Practicum
schools.scope: Human services leadership, people, finance, organizational learning and accountable management.

schools.name: School of Fundraising, Grants and Resource Mobilization
new: Ethical Fundraising and Resource Strategy
Donor Research and Relationship Stewardship
Grant Proposals Theory of Change and Budgets
Grant Compliance Reporting and Controls
Digital Fundraising and Responsible Storytelling
Resource Mobilization Proposal Practicum
schools.scope: Philanthropic income, grant quality, donor stewardship and accountability. Enterprise trading belongs to SEE.

schools.name: School of Advocacy, Human Rights and Legal Literacy
new: Human Rights Instruments and Local Legal Literacy
Legal Aid Referral Documentation and Access to Justice
Rights Based Campaign Design and Community Organizing
Strategic Advocacy and Accountability Practicum
schools.scope: Rights and access to justice, retaining forensic practice, restorative justice, reintegration and legislative advocacy without changing their assessments.

schools.name: School of Vocational and Technical Skills for Livelihoods
new: Livelihood Assessment and Vocational Pathway Planning
Foundational Digital and Workplace Skills
Green Skills and Sustainable Livelihood Pathways
Occupational Safety Rights and Inclusive Workplaces
Apprenticeship Employer Partnerships and Placement
Vocational Pathway Portfolio and Practice Assessment
schools.scope: Employability foundations and supported occupational pathways. Trade-specific competence requires qualified instructors, equipment and observed practice; online CBT alone is insufficient.

schools.name: School of Youth Development and Employability
new: Positive Youth Development and Youth Participation
Career Guidance Job Search and Transition Planning
Youth Livelihoods Financial Capability and Inclusion
Mentoring Life Skills and Workplace Readiness
Youth Programme Design and Transition Practicum
schools.scope: Youth participation and education-to-work pathways. The three retained school social work courses keep their original student-support outcomes.

schools.name: School of Aging, Disability and Inclusive Services
new: Disability Rights and the Social Model
Accessible Services Assistive Technology and Inclusion
Person Centred Integrated Care and Service Coordination
Caregiver Support Safeguarding and Social Participation
Inclusive Service Planning Practicum
schools.scope: Aging and disability across rights, care coordination, accessible services and participation; add disability depth beyond the retained gerontology courses.

schools.name: School of Global Partnerships, Ethics and Professional Standards
new: Global Social Work Ethics and Professional Standards
Equitable Partnerships and Localization
Intercultural Practice and Power Accountability
Partnership Governance Agreements and Due Diligence
Professional Quality Assurance and Continuing Development
Global Partnership Design Practicum
schools.scope: International collaboration, professional standards and reciprocal partnerships. Generalist ethics remains a foundational FSW competency.

schools.name: School of Social Work and Environmental Sustainability
new: Sustainability Systems and Social Work Practice
Sustainable Institutions Procurement and Operations
Circular Economy Waste and Community Wellbeing
Environmental Education and Behaviour Change
Sustainability Indicators and Impact Reporting
Institutional Sustainability Action Practicum
schools.scope: Institutional and community sustainability systems, circularity and environmental education, distinct from ERT adaptation and BLU coastal economies.

schools.name: School of Social Work and the SDGs
new: SDG Architecture Targets and Social Work Roles
Localizing the SDGs through Community Planning
Poverty Inequality Gender and Inclusion across SDGs
SDG Indicators Data and Accountability
SDG Partnerships Financing and Policy Coherence
Integrated SDG Action Plan Practicum
schools.scope: Integrated localization and accountability across the SDGs, using dedicated applied outcomes rather than rebadging individual subject courses.

schools.name: School of Social Work Nigerian Content and Community Development Planning
new: Nigerian Content Policy and Social Work Roles
Community Assets Needs and Development Planning
Local Supplier Participation and Enterprise Readiness
Inclusive Skills Employment and Community Linkages
Stakeholder Accountability and Content Monitoring
Nigerian Content Community Plan Practicum
schools.scope: Local participation, supplier and skills linkages and community development planning. Legal scope follows the Nigerian Content Act; distinguish SPIA trust governance.

schools.name: School of Social Work and the Petroleum Industry Act
new: Petroleum Industry Act and Social Work Practice Boundaries
Host Community Trust Structures and Governance
Participatory Needs Assessment and Development Plans
Trust Project Selection Budgets and Accountability
Grievance Handling Inclusion and Conflict Prevention
Host Community Development Planning Practicum
schools.scope: PIA-specific host community development and trust accountability. Verify operative law and regulations before drafting; do not treat a consultation draft as law.

schools.name: School of Social Work in Disasters and Conflict
new: Conflict Analysis Sensitivity and Do No Harm
Displacement Protection and Durable Solutions
Peacebuilding Mediation and Community Dialogue
Trauma Informed Support in Conflict Affected Communities
Disaster Conflict Nexus and Recovery Planning
Conflict Sensitive Recovery Practicum
schools.scope: Conflict-sensitive protection, displacement and recovery across the disaster-conflict nexus. Operational humanitarian response stays in HDR.
